purpose: Review a client code change for security and correctness defects and issue an evidence-backed APPROVE or BLOCK per lens.
substance_rationale: Independent code review of a client change before merge is work a client pays a consultant for.

steps.description: Security lens: injection, SSRF, path traversal, secrets, access control. Cites a CWE per finding.
Correctness lens: logic errors, edge cases, broken invariants, each with a triggering input.
